text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—It is almost the appointed time, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Everything stems from daily practice. The 
teachings learned from you, Trainer, 
breathe within me and manifest naturally 
when I run.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, even if my soul blazes with a 
fierce fighting spirit, my mind remains 
like flowing water.
choice_data_list: Go show them everything you've learned!

Go out there and show them everything 
you've learned!
